description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor, which is responsible for processing email notifications related to status changes of leave requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements methods to generate email content replacements and determine recipients based on leave status change events, adhering to the application's mail processing conventions.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for processing email notifications regarding change in leave request statuses. It generates email content by replacing placeholders with actual data and determines email recipients based on roles and leave details. Implements the MailProcessor interface and extends an abstract email processor for leave-related emails.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates an array of placeholder replacements for email content, extracting relevant leave and user information from the LeaveStatusChange event to personalize email notifications.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients based on the specified recipient role and the leave status change event, ensuring the correct stakeholders are notified.

methods.name: verifyLeavesFromOneLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates that all leave entries involved in the event belong to the same leave request, throwing an exception if not.
